item.title: Boards — Canaan K230 (Kendryte K230 / CanMV-K230)
item.description: Dual-core 64-bit RISC-V C908: big core 1.6GHz with RVV1.0, little core 0.8GHz; KPU rated at 6 TOPS equivalent (INT8/INT16) (1 TOPS on the K230D); the CanMV-K230 board carries 512MB LPDDR4, microSD, HDMI, 3× MIPI-CSI and USB; typical chip power is about 2W
